problemSignature.risk: provider adapters could imply stock or assembly availability without a live API result

rootCause: BoardForge needed a product-grade sourcing provider contract where every BOM row carries sourcing, stock, assembly, pin-map, and risk fields without inventing live supplier evidence.
fixSummary: Add sourcing provider modules for Digi-Key, Mouser, LCSC, and JLCPCB assembly that disclose missing credentials and never claim API_VERIFIED until a real provider query is implemented and run.

conditions: BOM or manufacturing package needs part availability and assembly disclosure

recipe: Normalize every BOM row with MPN, manufacturer, symbol, footprint, pin-map status, sourcing status, stock status, assembly availability, and risk.
Return NOT_CHECKED when credentials are missing.
Return MANUAL_CANDIDATE for manually selected but unverified parts.
Return PLACEHOLDER for generated placeholder parts.
Use API_VERIFIED only after live provider evidence exists.
safetyRules: do not mark manufacturing-ready from unchecked sourcing evidence
